title: Canon envelope v1 (metadata.canon)
description: Envelope of a canon record v1, stored at metadata.canon of the record. The envelope never duplicates server-owned fields: title, tags, agent, project and dates live on the record itself; links between records live in server edges, not in the envelope. Unknown properties inside the envelope are forbidden — a typo (e.g. 'affets' instead of 'affects') must fail validation loudly. Per-type extras are required for their own type and rejected for every other type (conditional composition on 'type'). Canon §7 reserves status 'resolved' for task and report records; checkpoint and decision envelopes must not use it.

schema_version.description: Envelope format version; the string '1' for v1.

type.description: Artifact type. Selects the per-type extras below and the record-level schema.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the record. 'resolved' is valid only when type is task or report (canon §7); for checkpoint and decision it must be draft, active, superseded or deprecated.

language.description: Primary language of the record body. Fixed section headers are always EN regardless of this value.

session_ref.description: Reference to the source session, or null when the checkpoint is not tied to a session.

reversible.description: Whether the decision can be reversed without disproportionate cost.

period.description: Reporting period (e.g. '2026-W38'), or null when the report is not period-bound.

status.description: Canon §7: status 'resolved' is reserved for task and report types; checkpoint and decision records close via superseded/deprecated instead.
